title: Luna and the Moonlight Garden
author: Hamidreza Rostami
moral_lesson: Believe in magic, and your belief can bring it back to life.
short_description: A curious girl follows the moonlight into a secret garden and discovers that believing is the strongest magic of all.
long_description: Luna loves her grandmother's stories about the Moonlight Garden, a magical place that appears only when the moon is full. One night she follows the moonlight through her garden and finds that every flower glows, the plants dance, and a tiny silver door in an old oak tree opens for her. Out steps a magical ladybug who leads her to the great Heart Tree, where one sad branch has lost its belief. Luna reaches out and whispers, 'I believe in you' — and the magic returns. A gentle bedtime story about wonder, belief, and the courage to keep dreaming.
